comment: Provider model rates for informative, post-run cost figures - never control flow. Unit: USD per 1M tokens. cache_read/cache_write_* are absolute rates, not multipliers. A model absent here prices to null, never to 0.
source: LiteLLM model_prices_and_context_window.json (the pricing source ccusage uses), fetched 2026-09-11; anthropic rates cross-checked against pond's token-usage-accounting doc

openai.comment: cache_write_5m is listed for completeness; codex telemetry exposes no cache-write bucket (cached_input is a subset of input), so writes are already priced inside full-rate input until the telemetry grows one.

google.comment: Gemini bills context caching as storage per token-hour, which per-call token counts cannot express; agy usage rows carry no cache split, so input is priced at the full rate.
